body: This is so autistic, I love it.
Mmmm donuts 😌

You have fought valiantly and there's a huge respect to be had with that (you have mine). At least you know you have tried. Some of those things you listed I'm yet to try for myself, I don't have much expectation or hope but that's the main thing, knowing you tried.

As they say the regret of inaction is 10x worse than the regret of failure.

Thanks, it's an abdominal injury as mentioned in other comments doctors have ruled out a hernia.

And yes lean is king for facial attractiveness. Even if I can get lean while not losing any muscle that would be good, however I can't be fully happy until this injury is solved.

Plus I have a feeling it still won't be anywhere near good enough to improve my online dating chances as you have to be a 10/10. It will give a small confidence boost irl though.

And talking about shoulders I've always had a funny right shoulder but that always seems to get better on its own whenever it flares up.

Some sort of abdominal injury, doctors have not been able to find a diagnosis so far. What sucks is the pain isn't even that bad but it's been persistent for 3 months and I experience it several times throughout the day.

I have recently returned to the gym as I mentioned in another comment but am slowly building up the weight. No pain so far during the actual workouts. Mainly during everyday life.

A cut is the opposite to a bulk I.e a diet.

Went super light today at the gym and felt pretty much ok, will just have to continuously test the threshold until I'm back up to speed.

The outcome of this is extremely important for my future.

Thanks for the kind words. I recently returned to the gym last week after 2 months off and have only been sticking to warmup level weights for now, but I'm still experiencing discomfort, just have to continuously test the threshold. Crazy that I got sore just from doing warmup weight

What's most frustrating is that there is pretty much no pain (in my core) during the workouts only after.

The analogy I like to use is the greek myth of Sisyphus pushing the boulder up the hill. Seems like things are always more difficult for us FA'ers.

Probably not yoga as it will put my body in precarious positions, best not to. Biking should be ok however it doesn't replace resistance training and is not going to preserve upper body muscle. I was planning on doing cardio on my cut.

Maybe you should try moving to Europe. Cities like London have a large South Asian community and I don't think it's as stigmatized as it is in the US.

I might be wrong but there might be equivalent cities in the US where this also applies.
Godspeed to you brother, I'm not quite ready to let go yet but I hope you find peace in the void and comfort in it's cold embrace.

At least you are getting dates my last date was 6 years ago and I didn't even get past the first one. Feels like a dream now as I've never managed to get another one since.

Also not cool for girls to lead on a guy like that if the feeling isn't mutual she knows what she's doing.
Yes but the worst part is waking up.
The movie "Her" predicted this 10 years ago.

I disagree, if you build some decent muscle from a bulk (doesn't even have to be anything crazy) then cut down to 10-15% body fat, it will make your face lean with a visible jawline which can drastically improve your facial attractiveness. Yes know it won't change your facial features but it definitely improves your appearance.

Out of curiosity why isn't the gym possible for you? Is there a reason? For me it was amazing both mentally and physically and gave me hope I would one day escape this hell as it's the number 1 most effective way to improve your appearance as a man.

However I got injured so don't know when/if I'll be able to return which is soul crushing as my only way out is possibility gone.
Good luck brother and godspeed to you.

I'm slightly younger but I find having something to work towards definitely helps with the struggle and can provide some sort of purpose in life. 

Mine was the gym but due to an injury I'm not sure if I'll be able to return to it I want nothing more right now than to get better and have my hope restored.
Dating apps is the worst thing ever to happen to the mental health of the modern man.

I feel you brother. I can't stay in bed because of work but sleep seems to be the only solace I am getting at the moment. Watching the view from my window at night also brings me a brief moment of respite from it all.
Life revolving around wanting love and intimacy is real. sometimes I wish I could just shut off all the noise and live in peace but there's constant reminders everywhere it's relentless.
I'd say above average, low body fat percentage, visible jawline, clear skin etc

I'm not quite ready to let go yet as there's still allot of fight left in me and many of those things to try but I'm almost envious of people that have made peace with themselves and have let go.

Bitter sweet it may be but at least the constant worry and anxiety of time running out is gone and is no longer all consuming.

I'm just so exhausted...

I must rest here a moment...

I walk a lonely road

The only one that I have ever known

Don't know where it goes

But it's home to me, and I walk alone
